description: Front B (comprehensive catalog), O11 Reactive lane: port of tests/jobs-odc/external-site-and-events.json (plus the Description set and the external site rename of tests/jobs-odc/platform-events-lifecycle.json, here in the SAME job because there is only one file). Three types on the edges of the app. (1) ISystemEvent: IESpace.CreateOnApplicationReady/Resume/BeginWebRequest/SessionStart take no arguments, so the 'name' of the create is ignored and the reflection order is what chooses; the O11 map (docs/mapa/criar-reactive-ui.json) recorded OnApplicationReady born with Error InvalidFlow_NoStart, so Start, body and End are the author's; the @espace get shows which one was born. In O11 Reactive it is a CLIENT flow (the map refuses IAggregateNode inside it), so only Assign with ClientSide functions. (2) IExternalSite: UI flow node (IMobileFlow.CreateNode<T>), URL and Description writable (model-api-11.55.69); the second one receives a URL input parameter and, unlike ODC, is linked to an ILink with the URL argument filled in, so it is not left orphan. The first is the destination of the button, is renamed and the OnClick stays linked by key. (3) IEvent (Extended Event): IContainer.CreateEvent()/IInput.CreateEvent(), without a name; Event (closed list of DOM names) and Handler (a screen action without outputs). Results independent per lane; nothing here has been run natively yet.
